measurements.note:
[why] TOQ on every NVIDIA PC with a CUDA 12.4 or newer driver, without a profile for its GPUs: the trellis weights can only be read by the toq engine, and today its compute exists only for CUDA. The cuda-12 build also works with CUDA 13 drivers. For CPU and Vulkan, just add a profile below with that build, when the engine has it.
[split] The GPUs, the layer map (LLAMA_LAYER_DEVICES) and the context are computed by the app from the GPUs' memory (engine-cfg/split.rs), up to 128k. The image encoder (about 1.5 GB) goes on a GPU the model leaves free, otherwise on the main one (MTMD_BACKEND_DEVICE): on the CPU this engine produces random text for images.
[args] Those of the RTX 3060 Ti + GTX 1080 + GTX 1660 SUPER profile that are needed to make the engine work: -wgt 1 and -ub 512 are the measurements split.rs sizes the buffers on, -sm layer is needed by the layer map, q8_0 cache, --image-min-tokens 1024 as in that profile. The optimizations measured only on those GPUs (MTP, pre-Ampere CUDA graphs, q8 prompt prefill) are left out: they are added after a measurement on the PC, with its own profile.
